claims.assertion: Yazhi says Toleka-class ships can open large hangar panels to space while shields maintain onboard air and 1.2-bar pressure.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She identifies the shields as the primary source of pressurization.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says the fleet includes nine Toleka heavy cruisers and nine Sadicleya light cruisers built at one-third their size.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: Anéeka says Rashell ordered a flat top on Ritol so it could carry another large ship.
